task_order_rule: Design contracts and governance first, then domain and architecture, then module/HLD/LLD, then traceability and validation.

done_when: All required artifact names are declared.
economics_notes: Prevents late rework by freezing artifact shape before code generation.
Reduces audit preparation effort through standard file contracts.
tasks.title: Create deterministic Phase 10 artifact contracts

done_when: Economics requirements exist and are traceable.
economics_notes: Avoids fake ROI by requiring official or user-provided data.
tasks.title: Generate requirements analysis with governance and economics

economics_notes: Shows operational drivers such as triage, aging, re-open, and reconciliation.
Prevents costly unsafe integration with live payment systems.
tasks.title: Write domain analysis with payment and mock ecosystem boundaries

done_when: At least three options are documented.
Each option has pros, cons, economics, and governance fit.
economics_notes: Compares build cost, run cost, future change cost, and over-engineering risk.
Protects current laptop-scale project from premature heavy infrastructure.
tasks.title: Compare multiple architecture options

done_when: ADR explains consequences and no-certification posture.
tasks.title: Record architecture decision with economic justification

done_when: All external participants are mock adapters.
Ports/adapters are named in module design.
economics_notes: Reduces switching cost and future refactoring cost.
Keeps mock participants replaceable and safe.
tasks.title: Create module-level design with ports and adapters

done_when: LLD includes failure modes and debug guide.
economics_notes: Early debug design reduces future maintenance cost.
Quality attributes reduce incident and rework cost.
tasks.title: Create HLD and LLD with quality and debugging details

done_when: Every requirement maps to at least one design artifact.
Every requirement maps to at least one WBS task.
economics_notes: Reduces reviewer and audit navigation cost.
Prevents orphan requirements and hidden scope creep.
tasks.title: Build requirement-to-design-to-task traceability

economics_notes: Failing early is cheaper than generating code from weak planning.
Validation gives a repeatable demo gate.
tasks.title: Validate Phase 10 lifecycle planning readiness
